seo.title: How it works — ACOMI
seo.description: Create a space, set up beds or menus depending on type, add tenants or customers, and run occupancy or headcount.

howItWorksPage.title: Mess setup and lodging setup are different.
howItWorksPage.description: Space type is chosen once. Mess starts from menus and customers. PG, hostel, co-living, and rental start from property.
howItWorksPage.messBody: Menu library, today's menu, share. Customers are optional at first. No building or bed map.
howItWorksPage.lodgingBody: Quick Setup or manual builder. Then add residents. Meals are optional except rental, which omits the meal milestone.
howItWorksPage.inviteIntro: Invite a mobile number, or create a record without the app.

create.title: Create your space
create.line: Register with name, Indian mobile, and password. Choose Mess, PG, Hostel, Co-living, or Rental.

setUp.title: Set up operations
setUp.line: Lodging starts from buildings and beds. Mess starts from menus and serving locations.

addPeople.title: Add people
addPeople.line: Tenants on lodging. Customers on Mess. Staff and managers on both.

runDay.title: Run the day
runDay.line: Lodging: occupancy, dues, issues. Mess: participation, headcount, meal dues, food issues.

invite.0: Owner or manager invites a 10-digit Indian mobile with a role.
invite.1: That person registers or signs in with the same mobile and a password.
invite.2: They accept. Tenants and customers may complete a profile.
invite.3: They see stay, meals, proofs, and complaints that apply to them — not the full operator console.

seo.title: Who ACOMI is for
seo.description: Equal weight for Mess and PG operators, plus hostel, co-living, and rental. Not a PG marketplace.

whoItsForPage.title: Sold to owners. Used by invited people.
whoItsForPage.description: ACOMI is for operators of Indian shared living and messes. Tenants, meal customers, and staff join by invitation. This site is not for people looking for a PG.

mess.title: Mess operators
mess.body: Meal-first: customers, menus, breakfast/lunch/dinner participation, daily headcount, meal billing. No rooms or beds.

pg.title: PG owners
pg.body: Paying Guest operators: occupancy, tenants, optional meals when food is included, dues, complaints.

hostel.title: Hostel operators
hostel.body: Hostel beds and rooms, occupancy lifecycle, members, dues, and issues.

coliving.title: Co-living operators
coliving.body: Shared units, occupancy, members, optional meals, dues.

rental.title: Rental operators
rental.body: Flats and rooms as units — occupancy and tenants. Not a listing marketplace. Meals are not required.
